Let's explore the top five cruise destinations that will transform your travel dreams into reality.

1. The Caribbean: Paradise Found

Why It's a Must-Visit

The Caribbean remains America's favorite cruise destination for good reason. With its turquoise waters, powdery white-sand beaches, and vibrant island cultures, it offers the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure. Get Go Travels offers Caribbean cruises that visit stunning ports like:

  • St. Thomas for world-class shopping and snorkeling
  • Cozumel for ancient Mayan ruins and crystal-clear cenotes
  • The Bahamas for swimming with pigs and private island escapes

Best Time to Cruise

The Caribbean offers great cruising year-round, but the ideal months are:

  • December to April for perfect weather
  • May and November for fewer crowds and lower prices

Get Go Travels Special Tips

✔ Book a private cabana on cruise line private islands
✔ Try local jerk chicken in Jamaica
✔ Don't miss the colorful architecture of Old San Juan

2. Alaska: America's Last Frontier

Why It's a Must-Visit

Alaska cruising offers breathtaking natural wonders you can't experience anywhere else. With Get Go Travels, you'll:

  • Sail past massive glaciers calving into the sea
  • Spot whales, bears, and eagles in their natural habitat
  • Explore frontier towns rich with Gold Rush history

Best Time to Cruise

The short Alaska cruise season runs:

  • May to September (peak wildlife viewing in July/August)
  • June offers the best balance of weather and prices

Get Go Travels Special Tips

✔ Choose a balcony cabin for glacier viewing
✔ Pack layered clothing for changing weather
✔ Book helicopter tours to land on glaciers

3. The Mediterranean: History and Luxury Combined

Why It's a Must-Visit

Mediterranean cruises with Get Go Travels let you:

  • Walk through ancient ruins in Rome and Athens
  • Sample authentic Italian pasta and French wines
  • Soak in the stunning cliffside views of Santorini

Best Time to Cruise

The Mediterranean shines during:

  • April-June for mild weather and spring blooms
  • September-October for comfortable temperatures

Get Go Travels Special Tips

✔ Arrive a day early to explore departure cities
✔ Learn basic phrases like "grazie" and "merci"
✔ Consider private guides for in-depth tours

4. Hawaii: America's Tropical Paradise

Why It's a Must-Visit

Hawaiian cruises with Get Go Travels offer:

  • Visits to four islands without packing/unpacking
  • Volcano tours and black sand beaches
  • Authentic luaus and hula performances

Best Time to Cruise

Hawaii welcomes visitors year-round with:

  • April-June and September-December for best prices
  • Winter months for whale watching

Get Go Travels Special Tips

✔ Try shave ice with tropical flavors
✔ Book a helicopter tour of the Na Pali Coast
✔ Don't miss the sunrise at Haleakalā

5. Northern Europe: Castles and Fjords

Why It's a Must-Visit

Northern Europe cruises with Get Go Travels feature:

  • Norwegian fjords with towering cliffs
  • Baltic capitals like Stockholm and Copenhagen
  • Russian history in St. Petersburg

Best Time to Cruise

The short season offers:

  • May-August for midnight sun
  • September for fall colors

Get Go Travels Special Tips

✔ Pack a light jacket even in summer
✔ Book St. Petersburg tours early
✔ Try Swedish meatballs in Stockholm
